articles.title: Seahawks fan chat: Who do you want to see lose more, the Rams or 49ers?
articles.summary: The 49ers and Rams battle for the right to not immediately fall behind the Seattle Seahawks to start the 2026 NFL season.
articles.body:
The Seattle Seahawks started their 2026 season with a comeback win over the New England Patriots , ensuring that they'll be ahead of at least one of the San Francisco 49ers or Los Angeles Rams by the end of Week 1. Seattle and New England had to play on Wednesday to accommodate the Niners and Rams debuting regular season NFL in Australia. What is technically a Thursday night game in the United States is a Friday morning kickoff in Melbourne, and we'll soon find out if staying in Australia for a week is a better strategy than flying in about as late as reasonably possible like the Rams did.

While unfortunately both of these teams cannot start the season 0-1, we'll either see one of them at 0-1 by the end of tonight or 0-0-1 in the unlikely event of a tie. Consider that the 49ers play the Miami Dolphins and Arizona Cardinals the next two weeks and they could start the season 3-0, two weeks out before they face the Seahawks. Meanwhile, the Rams still have the Denver Broncos , Philadelphia Eagles , and Buffalo Bills to come over the next few weeks, so it's not like they have an easy schedule. It's a division game, so the tiebreakers will be very important for Seahawks fans to watch.

The 49ers are as healthy as can be as far as their star players, while the Rams have everyone except Aaron Donald all good to go.

Netflix has the broadcast at 5:35 pm PT, so if you're already on Netflix binge-watching something, you can catch some NFL football on the side.

Join us in the comments, and don't forget that we have a new SB Nation mobile app ( available in the United States and now available in Canada! ), which was put to great use by many of you on Wednesday during the Seahawks-Patriots game thread! While tonight's game is technically not a "game thread" we would put in the live chat, here's a sampler of what being in a Field Gulls live game chat would look like.

articles.title: Patriots WR A.J. Brown expected to miss at least 4 weeks with high ankle sprain
articles.summary: An MRI on Thursday confirmed the injury, which Brown sustained during New England's loss to the Seahawks on Wednesday.
articles.body:
The New England Patriots might be without star wide receiver A.J. Brown for longer than they hoped.

An MRI on Thursday reportedly confirmed that Brown suffered a high ankle sprain, per NFL Network's Ian Rapoport . Brown is expected to miss at least four weeks with the injury, per Rapoport. High ankle sprains typically require four to six weeks of recovery.

Brown suffered the injury during the third quarter of Wednesday night's loss to the Seattle Seahawks , with the 29-year-old receiver grabbing at his lower right leg after an incompletion. Brown stayed down while athletic staff tended to him before he was helped off the field.

Postgame, Brown was reportedly seen leaving the locker room in a walking boot on his right foot. Prior to leaving the game, Brown had three receptions for 26 yards.

Overall, it wasn't the best night for the Patriots, with quarterback Drake Maye throwing a mind-boggling interception to basically end the game, and receiver Romeo Doubs notably failing to grab any of his three targets, including a brutal drop in the second half. The Seahawks rallied to a 13-10 win after scoring 10 points in the fourth quarter.

Given the recovery timeline, it's possible the Patriots will choose to place Brown on injured reserve, which will require him to miss the next four games. New England 's next game isn't until Sept. 20 (as a result of the unusual Wednesday opener), but a four-week absence would land Brown's return somewhere around the Patriots' Week 6 game against the New York Jets .

Brown wasn't the only notable injury in Wednesday's game: Seattle quarterback Sam Darnold went down with a hip injury very early in the matchup. However, Darnold's outlook appears more optimistic, as the veteran QB avoided a fracture and is instead reportedly dealing with an unusual muscle strain .

The Patriots had acquired Brown from the Philadelphia Eagles as part of a big offseason trade in June, with the hope of reigniting the receiver's talent. Instead, it looks like they'll be without him for the first chunk of the year.

articles.title: San Francisco 49ers vs Los Angeles Rams inactives: Who’s in & out for NFL Australia battle?
articles.summary: The San Francisco 49ers and Los Angeles Rams will make NFL history Thursday in Australia, but several players will miss the historic matchup.
articles.body:
The NFL season-opening week continues Thursday in the Land Down Under! The San Francisco 49ers and Los Angeles Rams are set to kick off the NFL's first-ever game in Australia.

Los Angeles and San Francisco will battle at Melbourne Cricket Ground (MCG) in Melbourne. Kickoff is set for 8:30 p.m. ET, with the game streaming exclusively on Netflix. While fans are excited to see meaningful football continue its return, several key players will be missing for both teams.

George Kittle and Christian McCaffrey are among the notable players active for the 49ers.

However, both teams will be without multiple wide receivers, and each has a third-string/emergency quarterback designated for the game.

articles.title: Jahmyr Gibbs Named a Major Winner of Lions Offseason
articles.summary: Jahmyr Gibbs got paid this offseason, and one Lions writer thinks the bigger prize is still coming. #Lions
articles.body:
Detroit Lions running back Jahmyr Gibbs was rewarded in August with a three-year, $67.5 million contract extension , a deal that made him the highest-paid running back in NFL history as he enters his fourth season. He is one of the core pieces on this offense for the Lions.

Gibbs is primed for a huge season after the Lions traded running back David Montgomery to the Houston Texans in March. As the featured three-down back, it is quite possible that Gibbs can carry the ball more than 300 times in the 2026 NFL season.

Candace Pedraza of Side Lion Report listed five winners and three losers from the offseason as Week 1 of the 2026 NFL season approaches. Gibbs landed on the winners side alongside the rookie class, Aidan Hutchinson , Isaac TeSlaa and the team's undrafted free agents. Pedraza wrote:

"Gibbs has an excellent shot at winning OPOY or MVP, or both, this season. He's not only about to see a major uptick in carries this season with the trade of Montgomery going down this offseason, but the Lions' "light" schedule should make his ability to break some rushing records fairly simple. That's all assuming, of course, that the Lions' offensive line makes his life this easy. But, coming off a historic extension and getting handed the keys to the ground game should be extra motivation for a competitor like Gibbs this season."

Gibbs rushed for 1,223 yards on 243 carries with 13 touchdowns last season, averaging 5.0 yards per carry. He also caught 77 passes for 616 yards and five touchdowns, averaging 8.0 yards per reception. Gibbs finished seventh in the NFL in rushing yards and tied for 11th in carries. It would not be a surprise to see him in the top five in both categories this season.

articles.title: 49ers vs. Rams score, live updates: Myles Garrett makes debut for LA vs. an already banged-up San Francisco roster in Melbourne
articles.summary: The San Francisco 49ers and LA Rams head to Melbourne in Week 1 for the league's first-ever matchup in Australia.
articles.body: Week 1 of the 2026 NFL season continues Thursday night with the league's first regular-season game to take place in Australia, as the San Francisco 49ers and Los Angeles Rams face off in an NFC West battle in Melbourne.The Rams enter the season as Super Bowl favorites following the offseason acquisition of All-Pro defensive end Myles Garrett playing opposite reigning MVP Matthew Stafford and All-Pro receiver Puka Nacua. Even at full strength, the 49ers would have their hands full, but San Francisco enters with a few question marks remaining regarding the health of several stars. Star edge rusher Nick Bosa will make his season debut returning from a torn ACL suffered last season with limited camp reps under his belt, while All-Pro tight end George Kittle makes his way back from a ruptured Achilles that ended his 2025 campaign. Oh, then there's Christian McCaffrey, who's been in and out of practices through the preseason, limited with tightness … after already losing wide receiver Ricky Pearsall for the year with a knee injury. Yeesh. Amid all of that, the 49ers enter as 3.5-point "down under" underdogs. Follow along with Yahoo Sports to see how it all plays out.Where to watch 49ers vs. Rams49ers-Rams start time: 8:35 pm. ETLocation: Melbourne Cricket Ground | East Melbourne, AustraliaTV channel/live stream: Netflix
